def sha256(path):
    h = hashlib.sha256()

            h.update(chunk)
    return h.hexdigest()

def read_text(path):
    return Path(path).read_text(encoding='utf-8', errors='replace')

def parse_energy(path):
    text = read_text(path)
    vals = re.findall(r'FINAL SINGLE POINT ENERGY\s+(-?\d+\.\d+)', text)
    if not vals:
        vals = re.findall(r'Total Energy\s*:\s*(-?\d+\.\d+)', text)
    if not vals:
        raise ValueError(f'No final single point energy found in {path}')
    return float(vals[-1])
